create_bullet_client_headless: create a BulletClient with pybullet.DIRECT mode to start a headless physics simulation
create_bullet_client_gui: create a BulletClient with pybullet.GUI mode to start a physics simulation with a graphical interface
connect_bullet_client_shared_memory: create a BulletClient with pybullet.SHARED_MEMORY to connect to an existing running simulation
disconnect_bullet_client: disconnect a BulletClient from its physics simulation to clean up resources
review_bullet_client_getattr: review the BulletClient __getattr__ method that injects the client id into pybullet functions
